The npm registry the plugin market resolves and downloads plugins from.
Default: https://registry.npmjs.org/ . Where that is slow or unreachable,
a mirror of it works, for example https://registry.npmmirror.com/ .
Every install is still checked against the integrity hash the catalog
recorded for that exact version, and the check reads from whichever
registry is configured here — so a mirror serving different bytes is
refused, not trusted. Point this only at a mirror of the public registry;
